calls.video_title: My Forever Portfolio: 4 Spectacular Stocks You Can Buy Now and Never Sell
calls.thesis: Forever-hold buy, first tracked call: capital-intensive manufacturing and distribution moat like Coca-Cola's; saturated, shrinking shelf space deters entrants.
calls.bull_case: Distribution moat endures in a slow-growth industry.
calls.bear_case: Slow growth and saturated markets cap the upside.
